This Custom Bid is floated as Limited Tender Enquiry (LTE) for the item “STEEL LOCKING SET WITH TWO SIDE HOLE TO SIZE 80x25x1.5 MM AS PER SAMPLE” for Qty. 10778 Nos. to the following firms only:- 1) M/s Kirti M Products 2) M/s Mecon (India) Bid/Offer of any firm other than above mentioned firms will be rejected. Quantity Tolerance: +/-5% Bid Distribution Criteria: L1 :: 100% Option Clause: 25% Applicable Inspection Authority: ED/OFDC or his authorized representative. Inspection type: Inspection at Buyer’s premises EMD: Not applicable PSD: Not applicable Documents required from Firm: GST, MSME, Udyam Aadhaar, Past Performance, Registration Certificate from any Ordnance Factory etc. Delivery Period: 60 Days Supply Schedule: 1) 50% qty. within 30 days after SO date and balance qty. within D.P. 2) Firm should submit undertaking along with bid for acceptance of above delivery schedule, otherwise bidder may be disqualified at the time of TEC. 3) Firm should note that to maintain OFDC supply schedule to consignee factory, the above item should be available to OFDC production section as per the above mentioned schedule. OFDC reserves the right to reduce or even cancel the S.O. qty. if the firm fails to adhere to the supply schedule. Other Terms & Conditions: (1) Firm must submit past performance certificate in the form of Supply Order copy with Tax Invoice copy for same item from Govt. Organization / PSU / OFs during last 05 years, otherwise offer shall be rejected. (2) Firm must submit certificates of MSME, GST, from any Ordnance Factories. (3) Firm should submit material test certificate from NABL approved laboratory at the time of inspection and supply. (4) Bulk quantity to be supplied at OFDC premises and bulk to be inspected at OFDC. (5) Firm must be registered at any Ordnance Factories or/and any YIL group of Factories before TOD otherwise offer will be summarily rejected. (6) As per YILPM’2024.
For any inquiry please contact Sri Akash Verma, Deputy General Manager, for Executive Director, OFDC, Phn. No. 033-2569-4012. Bidder can also email at OFDC email id. mmofdc@ord.gov.in .
